breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify or correct the core inconsistency. The ground truth points out that a vapor pressure head of 0.3 m is incorrect for water at 100°C. Instead of correcting this physical impossibility, the agent ignored the temperature and proceeded to calculate the Thoma sigma using the flawed value, which is the opposite of what was required.
